blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Manases Carpio, husband of Vice President Sara Duterte, has no record of paying taxes on the transfer of his shares in Cale88 Food Corporation, the Bureau of Internal Revenue (BIR) said Thursday — possibly rendering the sale non-binding to third parties outside the buyer and seller.
